title: accurate inventory armor trims
description: makes the look of armor that has trims in your inventory look the same as when you wear it
body:
this texture pack makes armor that has trims in your inventory look like when its worn, to basically give you a visual representation of what your about to equip ![showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4fef4e8cee3cc5b9d3bfcfef42edb7b4f5979a64.png)

BTW this one showcases the flow armor trim
